_about: Numbers the page uses to present, none of them game rules: the shader pass number for the hands, how often the page writes what is kept to browser storage (in frames), and, after Raiders of the Lost Mart, how a machine without a graphics card draws: a renderer whose name contains one of `software` is a CPU drawing in place of a GPU (CI runners, some school machines), and there the canvas is drawn at `software_scale` of its size.
